title: Solutions Architect
description: Job Title: Solutions Architect – Data Services Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week) Contract Duration: Through December 2026 (Possibility of Extension) Work Schedule: 8 hours/day (Mon-Fri) Work Hours: EST Location: 100% Remote - (Candidates can work from anywhere in LATAM Countries) Role Overview We are seeking an experienced Solutions Architect – Data Services to lead the design and delivery of enterprise-scale data solutions for a global consulting environment. This role is responsible for defining end-to-end architectures across modern data platforms, ensuring alignment with business objectives, governance standards, and enterprise architecture principles. The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in Azure Databricks, data engineering, and cloud-native architectures, along with hands-on experience in data mesh, data products, and Unity Catalog–based governance. This is a hands-on architect role, requiring both strategic thinking and practical execution through proof-of-concepts (POCs) and close collaboration with engineering teams. Key Responsibilities Solution & Data Architecture Define and own solution-level architectures across data platforms, with a focus on Azure Databricks (workspaces, compute, orchestration). Design and implement data mesh architectures and domain-oriented data products. Establish governance frameworks using Unity Catalog, including security, lineage, and multi-workspace strategies. Translate business requirements into scalable, secure, and production-ready data solutions. Identify cross-system dependencies, integration points, and architectural risks. Data Platform Design & Governance Define best practices for data ingestion, transformation, and serving within Databricks. Establish standards for data product ownership, contracts, and lifecycle management. Implement enterprise-grade security and access control using Unity Catalog, Entra ID, and cloud-native tools. Ensure alignment with enterprise governance, compliance, and security policies. Contribute to reusable architecture patterns and platform standards. Hands-on Execution & Proof-of-Concepts Design and execute POCs to validate architectural decisions and reduce delivery risk. Remain hands-on with: Python for data engineering, notebooks, and automation C# / Python for APIs, integrations, and platform services Support engineering teams by reviewing designs, resolving technical challenges, and ensuring architectural alignment. Collaboration & Delivery Alignment Partner with Product Management and business stakeholders to shape features and solution direction. Collaborate with System Architects to align solution and system-level designs. Guide Agile teams through architecture decisions during planning and execution. Participate in architecture reviews and continuous improvement initiatives. Technical Leadership & Mentorship Provide guidance and mentorship to architects, tech leads, and senior engineers. Promote best practices in data architecture, engineering, and cloud platform design. Lead design reviews, technical discussions, and knowledge-sharing sessions. Architecture Documentation Develop architecture artifacts including C4 models and design documentation. Create High-Level Designs (HLDs) and Low-Level Designs (LLDs), including sequence diagrams and data flows. Document functional and non-functional requirements aligned with architectural designs. Required Qualifications 7+ years of experience in software engineering, data engineering, or architecture roles. Proven experience designing and delivering data platforms on Azure Databricks. Strong understanding of data mesh concepts and domain-oriented data products. Hands-on experience with Unity Catalog (governance, security, lineage). Solid programming experience in Python and/or C#, including API and integration design. Experience designing end-to-end solutions across data platforms, APIs, and cloud infrastructure. Strong knowledge of cloud-native architectures, DevOps practices, and operational considerations. Experience creating architectural artifacts and design documentation. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. Ability to operate in complex environments with ambiguity and evolving requirements. Preferred Qualifications Prior experience as a Solutions Architect, System Architect, or Senior Technical Lead. Experience working in consulting or large enterprise environments. Familiarity with Agile frameworks (e.G., SAFe) and PI Planning. Experience with diagram-as-code tools such as Structurizr, PlantUML, or Mermaid. Key Competencies Strategic thinking with a hands-on, delivery-focused mindset Strong problem-solving and analytical skills Ability to bridge business and technical stakeholders Leadership and mentorship capabilities Continuous learning and innovation mindset

mentoria técnica de desenvolvedores juniores e plenos: revisões de design, pair programming e transferência de conhecimento do domínio financeiro.- Participar ativamente de reuniões técnicas de equipe para discussão e alinhamento de demandas, soluções e prioridades.- Monitorar tendências e tecnologias, contribuindo com propostas de melhoria de processos e ferramentas utilizadas no desenvolvimento dos produtos da empresa.Desenvolvimento Assistido por IA- Utilizar ferramentas de desenvolvimento assistido por IA (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) de forma produtiva e responsável no ciclo diário de desenvolvimento: geração de código, revisão, debugging e escrita de testes.- Elaborar e consumir especificações técnicas otimizadas para uso com LLMs, garantindo que a documentação sirva tanto para a equipe quanto como contexto de alta qualidade para ferramentas de IA generativa.- Aplicar engenharia de prompts no contexto de desenvolvimento: formular contextos precisos, decompor problemas e validar criticamente as saídas de modelos de linguagem.Requisitos Técnicos:- Formação acadêmica: Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas dependências, REST controllers, transações, testes).- Experiência sólida em Oracle Database (PL/SQL, pipelined functions, partitioning, performance tuning, schemas complexos).- Conhecimento prático de Kubernetes (OKE) e deployments em containers (Docker, WebLogic em OKE).- Experiência com padrões de arquitetura: metadata-driven designs, cache distribuído (Caffeine/Redis), event-driven, repository pattern.- Familiaridade com ferramentas de desenvolvimento modernas: Git e Git Flow, pipelines CI/CD, Postman/OpenAPI.- Experiência prática com ferramentas de desenvolvimento assistido por IA: Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot ou similares — incluindo uso em geração de código, escrita de testes, refatoração e debugging.- Capacidade de engenharia de prompts aplicada ao desenvolvimento: saber title: Full Stack Engineer
description: We are looking for a full-time, remote Senior Full Stack Engineer with 5+ years of full stack development experience and a strong background in React.Js and Node.Js. You will join our clients engineering team and transform ideas and user feedback into positive experiences. You will work closely with other engineers and the user experience team iterating on designs and releasing them. Your responsibilities will include end-to-end feature development from web interfaces to backend APIs to the database. You will also communicate with the clients customers understanding their needs so you can build features with them that deliver on what you learn. The client fosters collaboration and a close-knit working environment within its development team valuing inclusion and independent thought from its members. The client will support you as you onboard and grow within your new role, and they expect you to provide the same support to other team members. You will manage your own workload by participating in sprint planning, voicing concerns, advocating for desirable development outcomes, and proactively addressing issues. The right candidate will join a team built to produce great software! Successful full stack engineers must have in-depth knowledge of web development concepts, a solid understanding of API and relational database design, excellent coding skills, familiarity with single page applications, and an eagerness to learn. Our client makes trust building in business relationships effortless. With greater trust comes greater business growth. At their core, our client takes the drudgery out of compliance by automating critical compliance activities and bringing joy into a traditionally drab space. The clients software platform allows companies quickly and cost effectively to adopt formal security and privacy programs, measure the efficacy of those programs against compliance standards, and share program achievements with customers via AI to answer security questionnaires. As a result, compliance becomes habitual, simply to understand and implement, and continuously verifiable so businesses gain transparency into compliance status. Responsibilities Collaborate with User Experience and Product teams creating end-to-end, new feature designs Build applications and APIs in JavaScript using React.Js and Node.Js Develop and implement highly responsive UI components Create data models using RDBMS principles implementing them in PostgreSQL Troubleshoot interfaces and debug applications Monitor and improve end-to-end performance Communicate with and support our customers helping them find and build solutions to their problems Required Experience Excellent English communication and interpersonal skills 5+ years of full stack software development experience writing single page applications that talk to API back-ends with a strong background with React.Js, Node.Js, JavaScript, CSS, and HTML Well-developed understanding of front-end concepts and different frameworks Strong back-end experience designing APIs and domain models Experience working in an AWS (preferred), GCP, Azure, or other cloud environments Experience designing RDBMSs to support real-world application usage Excellent troubleshooting skills and experience with browser-based debugging and performance-testing software A focus on customer value delivery Proven delivery experience in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment Great listening skills and a willingness to understand what customers and team members need to achieve success A collaborative approach, a can do attitude, and a relentless pursuit to attain goals and solve problems A willingness to learn from others and admit when youve made a mistake Desired Experience University degree in computer sciences/engineering or related field Additional Information Typical week is 40-45 hours, Monday Friday 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and your national holidays Start: ASAP Core Client Values The clients values are threaded into the very fabric of their culture. Trust : We strive to continuously earn the trust of our team, customers, investors, and all other stakeholders proving we are dependable. Health : We are diligent caretakers of the health of the business, but never prioritize it over the mental and physical health of our team. Respect : We are passionate about being respectful and courteous. Theres no excuse for being a jerk. Evidence-Based Decisions : Our strategy and operations are driven by evidence, which we collect from our customers, product, team, and partners. Accountability : We are fanatical about transparency and hold ourselves accountable for everything we do. Diversity : We work hard to nurture a team that is diverse in identity, belief, background, thought, and experience. Our diversity makes us stronger. The client celebrates diversity. Joyfully building a product that everyone loves requires a team with different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. It is why they are committed to bringing people onboard from diverse backgrounds, races, religions, national origins, gender identities, sexual orientations, gender identities, ages, disabilities, or veteran statuses. About Velozient We are a privately-held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Tech Lead Ruby On Rails
description:

Com atuação em mais de 16 países, mais de 2.000 unidades, mais de 23 mil colaboradores e um ecossistema completo de marcas, impactamos milhões de pessoas todos os dias por meio de experiências que promovem saúde, movimento e qualidade de vida. Trabalhar no Grupo Smart Fit é levar na carreira a força de um grande grupo global, com visão de longo prazo, estrutura robusta e oportunidades reais de crescimento, mobilidade entre marcas e novos desafios ao longo da jornada. Tudo isso em uma cultura de alta performance, forte, colaborativa e conectada ao nosso propósito. Nosso ecossistema reúne marcas que atuam em diferentes frentes do fitness e bem-estar: academias como Smart Fit, Bio Ritmo e Nation CT;
studios como Race Bootcamp, Vidya Studio, Jab House, Tonus Gym, Aera Pilates, Velocity e Kore;
e produtos digitais, TotalPass e Queima Diária. Principais responsabilidades: 1. Liderança Técnica e Arquitetura Guardião da Base de Código: Definir e zelar pelos padrões de código (\ "The Rails Way\"), garantindoque a API seja sólida para os projetos Web e Mobile. Tomada de Decisão Técnica: Escolher as melhores tecnologias, bibliotecas e padrões que equilibrem rapidez de entrega com sustentabilidade futura. Apoio à Gestão: Ser o braço direito do Gerente de TI e do GP, ajudando na estimativa de prazos, viabilidade de features e priorização técnica do backlog. 2. Qualidade, Integração e Homologação Garantia de Eficiência no Processo: Homologar as integrações da API com os times de Front-end (Web e Mobile), garantindo que os contratos de dados sejam cumpridos e a performance seja máxima. Revisão de Código (Code Review): Liderar as revisões de código dos parceiros, assegurando que nenhum débito técnico crítico entre em produção. Estratégia de Testes: Definir a política de cobertura de testes e garantir que o time utilize mocks e ferramentas como VCR para manter a agilidade no desenvolvimento. 3. Sustentação, Suporte e Performance Atendimento de Chamados Nível 3: Atuar como ponto focal em problemas complexos de produção, realizando a análise de causa raiz e orientando o time na correção definitiva. Otimização Contínua: Monitorar gargalos de performance no servidor e no banco de dados, implementando melhorias proativas para suportar o crescimento do app. 4. Aprendizado e Melhoria Contínua Radar Tecnológico: Manter o time atualizado com as novas versões do Ruby e do Rails, avaliando quando migrar ou adotar novas práticas. Cultura de Inovação Pragmática: Estimular o uso de ferramentas de IA para ganho de produtividade, sem abrir mão da segurança e da qualidade do código. O que buscamos Pessoas que: Dominem Arquitetura de Sistemas com Ruby on Rails: Domínio profundo de Rails em modo API e Monolitos, com habilidade para desenhar arquiteturas escaláveis, modulares e de fácil manutenção. Têm experiência com Design de APIs e Contratos: Expertise em arquitetura RESTful, versionamento e, principalmente, na definição de contratos de dados que atendam de forma eficiente Web e Mobile. Têm experiência com Engenharia de Testes Avançada: Domínio total de RSpec, incluindo estratégias complexas de mocking com VCR e WebMock, garantindo pipelines de CI/CD rápidos e determinísticos. Têm experiência com Modelagem e Performance de Dados: Maestria em PostgreSQL, otimização de queries, gestão de índices e estratégias de cache (Redis) para suportar aplicações de alta performance. Têm experiência com Segurança e Infraestrutura: Conhecimento sólido em protocolos de segurança (OAuth2, JWT), além de familiaridade com Docker e ambientes de deploy (AWS/Heroku/DigitalOcean). Adotem estrategicamente a IA: Capacidade de liderar o time no uso eficiente de ferramentas como GitHub Copilot ou Cursor para acelerar a geração de código, testes e documentação. Tenham pragmatismo e visão de Negócio: Foco em entregar a melhor solução técnica que respeite os prazos e objetivos da empresa, evitando\ "overengineering\". Tenham Liderança e Mentoria: Capacidade de elevar o nível técnico dos devs Plenos e Juniores através de Code Reviews educativos e suporte constante. Tenham Comunicação Estratégica e Proativa: Habilidade de traduzir requisitos de negócio (GP) em tarefas técnicas e alinhar expectativas com os times de Front/Mobile para evitar bloqueios. Têm experiência com Gestão de Crises e Decisão: Calma e assertividade para tomar decisões técnicas difíceis sob pressão e resolver incidentes críticos em produção. Tenham Atitude de Dono: Comprometimento total com a qualidade do produto final, antecipando gargalos e propondo melhorias antes que se tornem problemas.

title: Backend Team Lead
description: Backend Team Lead (PHP/Laravel) Location: Brazil Our trusted high-growth healthcare technology partner is seeking a talented Backend Team Lead (PHP/Laravel) to join their dynamic team. This innovative company is dedicated to revolutionizing the healthcare industry through cutting-edge technology solutions. Position Overview As a Backend Team Lead, you will play a key role in leading the backend development team while contributing to the development and implementation of scalable and robust software solutions that support the company's mission and goals. You will guide and support the backend team while working closely with cross-functional teams to design, build, and maintain innovative applications and platforms that drive business success and improve patient outcomes. Primary Responsibilities Team Leadership: Lead and support the backend engineering team, ensuring effective collaboration, task distribution, and delivery of high-quality software. Platform Development: Spearhead the development and optimization of our EHR platform using PHP/Laravel, ensuring high performance, reliability, and scalability. Database Development: Creating database schemas that represent and support business processes. API Development and Integration: Develop and maintain APIs for internal and external use, facilitating seamless integration with other healthcare systems and third-party services. Security Compliance: Ensure the platform's compliance with healthcare industry standards, including HIPAA, by implementing and maintaining robust security measures and data protection protocols. Additional Responsibilities Mentor backend developers, providing guidance on best practices in backend development, code review, and team collaboration. Support the team in resolving technical challenges and ensure consistent development standards across the team. Stay abreast of new technology trends and evaluate their application to continually innovate and enhance the platform. Participate in an agile development environment, contributing to team coordination and iterative delivery processes, ensuring timely delivery of high-quality software. Competencies / Requirements Technical Expertise: Strong proficiency in PHP/Laravel and MySQL. Familiarity with version control tools, preferably Git. Experience: At least 6+ years of experience in backend development, with a proven track record of developing and maintaining scalable web applications. Previous experience leading or mentoring developers is required. Experience in the healthcare sector or EHR platforms is highly desirable. Problem-Solving Skills: Ability to tackle complex problems, think analytically, and develop innovative solutions. Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, capable of effectively collaborating with cross-functional teams and stakeholders. Attention to Detail: A strong focus on code quality, adherence to design specifications, and a commitment to creating a user-friendly, secure, and efficient platform. Benefits Competitive salary to recognize and reward your achievements. Flexible work environment. Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

Nós elevamos continuamente o nível para fornecer produtos, serviços e processos de alta qualidade. Inovar para revolucionar: Encorajamos as pessoas a serem curiosas e a desafiarem o status quo. Ouvimos sempre novas ideias e estamos abertos a perguntas. Não temos medo de mudanças. Construção e valorização coletiva: Colabore com seus colegas e celebrem juntos as vitórias. Buscamos fornecer as melhores soluções e valores a longo prazo. title: Title Examiner (U.S. Real Estate)
description:
Job title: Title Researcher (U.S. Real Estate)Type of employment: Full-timeShift Schedule: Monday–Friday, 10:00AM – 7:00PM US Central TimeA specialized research role focused on identifying heirs, confirming ownership, and resolving title complexity for Texas property deals. You will conduct hands-on genealogy research, deep recorder-of-deeds investigations, and public records work to produce a complete, caller-ready research packet—so the sales and calling team can move cases forward without back-and-forth. Experience in genealogical research, property title investigation, probate, or U.S. public records research is highly preferred.About the CompanyA real estate acquisition firm specializing in resolving complex property issues—such as probate, liens, and title defects—to create win-win outcomes for heirs and owners of distressed Texas properties.Objectives of this Role- Accurate Identification: Produce comprehensive heirship profiles and contact pathways through professional genealogy.- Title Intelligence: Execute "Track B" deep-dive investigations to surface hidden defects and opportunities invisible to standard searches.- Operational Efficiency: Deliver structured, "caller-ready" research packets to the sales team to minimize back-and-forth and accelerate closing.- Complex Problem Solving: Resolve bottlenecks through expert-level skip tracing and public records forensics.Responsibilities- Genealogy & Heir Identification: Verify owner deaths via obituaries and public records;
build family trees using Ancestry.Com and alternative indicators (deed dates, court records).- Title Chain Research (Track A & B): Conduct full Title Intelligence Profile (TIP) investigations. Trace ownership via grantor/grantee and legal descriptions, analyze all recorded instruments, and flag breaks in chain or unreleased liens.- Public Records Investigation: Scour probate, tax, divorce, bankruptcy (PACER), and Secretary of State records to validate entity and individual status.- Advanced Skip Tracing: Locate hard-to-find heirs using social media and non-standard digital forensics;
verify all data againstthe heir profile.- CRM Documentation & Curative Support: Record structured findings in Podio;
identify required curative instruments (e.G., Affidavits of Heirship) and outline resolution paths.Required Skills and Qualifications- Genealogy Expertise: Professional experience building family trees and navigating birth/death/marriage/divorce records.- Advanced Title Search: Proven ability to read and interpret complex recorded documents and identify hidden title defects.- Public Records Proficiency: Mastery of county recorder portals, probate courts, and federal (PACER) databases.- Analytical Documentation: Ability to summarize complex legal/familial findings into concise, actionable English notes.- Technical Tools: High proficiency in Ancestry.Com and skip tracing platforms (TLO, Batch, or similar).Preferred Skills and Qualifications- Prior experience in U.S. Title Curative or Texas-specific property research.- Experience with Podio CRM.- Background in estate law, probate, or professional heir-hunting.- Bilingual (English/Spanish) is a plus.

title: Ai Quality Analyst (Portuguese)
description: Company Description MillionLogics, a trusted Oracle Partner, is a global IT solutions provider with offices in London, UK, and a development hub in Hyderabad, India. The company specialises in delivering smart, scalable, and future-ready IT solutions to empower businesses to evolve and lead. With expertise in Data & AI, Cloud migrations, IT consulting, and enterprise application optimisation, MillionLogics offers tailored services with a focus on client success. Supported by a team of over 50 AI & Oracle experts, MillionLogics combines cutting-edge technology with a commitment to delivering impactful outcomes. Learn more about our services on our website. Role Overview: As an AI Quality Analyst, you will evaluate a new personalisation feature for Gemini. You will assess how well the model uses information from your past Gemini conversations, Gmail, Google Search, and YouTube activity to make responses more relevant and helpful. This role requires a unique blend of creativity and analytical rigour. You will actively design prompts from the perspective of your own personal experiences. You will then use your analytical skills to assess the quality of the model's personalised responses, evaluating dimensions like Grounding, Integration, and Helpfulness. Offer Details: Pay: US$ 1500 per month (Net/take-home) Contract Duration: 12 months Number of Open Positions: 20 Key Qualifications Portuguese Proficiency: Ability to read and write in Portuguese with a high degree of comp, as Portuguese is the focus language for this project. Schedule Flexibility: Full-time availability in your local time zone is required. We are staffing a global, 24-hour operations team. Exceptional Analytical Thinking: Demonstrate ability to evaluate nuanced and ambiguous AI responses, specifically assessing personalisation quality. Creative Prompt Engineering: Experience in designing creative, multi-turn starting prompts based on personal context to thoroughly test the model's capabilities. Strong Evaluation Acumen: Understanding of personalisation concepts, including the ability to identify incorrect personalisation, poor inferences, and forced connections. Meticulous Attention to Detail: The ability to review Side-by-Side (SxS) model responses and spot subtle differences in naturalness and overnarrating. Excellent Written Communication: Superior ability to write clear, concise, and structured rationales for model rankings, explicitly referencing specific turn numbers. Feedback: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations. Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting. Technical Setup: Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection. Description: In this role, you will be part of a dynamic team focused on evaluating the quality of personalised AI interactions. Your day-to-day work will involve: Designing and executing multi-turn conversational prompts (typically 1-5 turns) that require the AI to utilise your personal information and experiences. Evaluating model responses based on your intent from the starting prompt, checking if the personalisation was appropriately applied. Analysing responses for Grounding issues, ensuring claims about you are supported by evidence and not flawed inferences or hallucinations. Assessing Integration quality to ensure personal data is woven naturally into the response without robotic\ "overnarrating\". Rigorouslyevaluating and stack-ranking two model responses side-by-side (SxS) to determine which is overall more helpful, easy to use, and enjoyable. Writing clear, defensible rationales for your comparisons, explicitly referencing where issues or positive aspects occurred in the conversation. Extracting and verifying\ "Debug Info\" from the modelto confirm that chat summaries and data sources were properly utilised. Maintaining strict data hygiene by deleting evaluation conversations to prevent them from polluting your future chat history. Education & Experience BS/BA degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field (e.G., Policy, Law, Ethics, Linguistics, Journalism, Computer Science, or a related analytical field). Experience in data annotation, AI quality evaluation, content moderation, or a related role is strongly preferred. Offer Details: Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and a minimum of 30 hours per week, with 4 hours of overlap with PST. (We have 2 options of time commitment: 30 hrs/week or 40 hrs/week) Engagement type: Contractor Evaluation Process - Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form. After the profile review, an assessment will be shared, which must be completed within 24 hours. Based on the assessment outcomes, shortlisted candidates will be contacted to discuss the pre‑onboarding requirements. How to Apply? Please send us your updated CV to with job ID: 62136 as your email subject.

title: Ai Quality Analyst (Portuguese)
description: Company Description MillionLogics, a trusted Oracle Partner, is a global IT solutions provider with offices in London, UK, and a development hub in Hyderabad, India. The company specialises in delivering smart, scalable, and future-ready IT solutions to empower businesses to evolve and lead. Role Overview: As an AI Quality Analyst, you will evaluate a new personalisation feature for Gemini. You will assess how well the model uses information from your past Gemini conversations, Gmail, Google Search, and YouTube activity to make responses more relevant and helpful. This role requires a unique blend of creativity and analytical rigour. You will actively design prompts from the perspective of your own personal experiences. You will then use your analytical skills to assess the quality of the model's personalised responses, evaluating dimensions like Grounding, Integration, and Helpfulness. Offer Details: Pay: US$ 1500 per month (Net/take-home) Contract Duration: 12 months Number of Open Positions: 20 Key Qualifications Portuguese Proficiency: Ability to read and write in Portuguese with a high degree of comp, as Portuguese is the focus language for this project. Schedule Flexibility: Full-time availability in your local time zone is required. We are staffing a global, 24-hour operations team. Exceptional Analytical Thinking: Demonstrate ability to evaluate nuanced and ambiguous AI responses, specifically assessing personalisation quality. Creative Prompt Engineering: Experience in designing creative, multi-turn starting prompts based on personal context to thoroughly test the model's capabilities. Strong Evaluation Acumen: Understanding of personalisation concepts, including the ability to identify incorrect personalisation, poor inferences, and forced connections. Meticulous Attention to Detail: The ability to review Side-by-Side (SxS) model responses and spot subtle differences in naturalness and overnarrating. Excellent Written Communication: Superior ability to write clear, concise, and structured rationales for model rankings, explicitly referencing specific turn numbers. Feedback: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations. Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting. Technical Setup: Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection. Description: In this role, you will be part of a dynamic team focused on evaluating the quality of personalised AI interactions. Your day-to-day work will involve: Designing and executing multi-turn conversational prompts (typically 1-5 turns) that require the AI to utilise your personal information and experiences. Evaluating model responses based on your intent from the starting prompt, checking if the personalisation was appropriately applied. Analysing responses for Grounding issues, ensuring claims about you are supported by evidence and not flawed inferences or hallucinations. Assessing Integration quality to ensure personal data is woven naturally into the response without robotic\ "overnarrating\". Rigorouslyevaluating and stack-ranking two model responses side-by-side (SxS) to determine which is overall more helpful, easy to use, and enjoyable. Writing clear, defensible rationales for your comparisons, explicitly referencing where issues or positive aspects occurred in the conversation. Extracting and verifying\ "Debug Info\" from the modelto confirm that chat summaries and data sources were properly utilised. Maintaining strict data hygiene by deleting evaluation conversations to prevent them from polluting your future chat history. Education & Experience BS/BA degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field (e.G., Policy, Law, Ethics, Linguistics, Journalism, Computer Science, or a related analytical field). Experience in data annotation, AI quality evaluation, content moderation, or a related role is strongly preferred. Offer Details: Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and a minimum of 30 hours per week, with 4 hours of overlap with PST. (We have 2 options of time commitment: 30 hrs/week or 40 hrs/week) Engagement type: Contractor Evaluation Process - Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form. After the profile review, an assessment will be shared, which must be completed within 24 hours. Based on the assessment outcomes, shortlisted candidates will be contacted to discuss the pre‑onboarding requirements. How to Apply? Please send us your updated CV to with job ID: 62136 as your email subject.

title: System Architect
description: Project Description: Owns the end-to-end vision and AI architecture for consumer devices. Defines scalable, power-efficient, and production-ready imaging and perception systems across product lines. Drives technical direction across sensor, ISP, CV, ML, and platform integration. Lead technology selection for inference engines, frameworks, and hardware platforms. Guide SoC bring-up and performance validation for vision pipelines. Establish coding standards, modularization strategy, and long-term maintainability. Identify technical risks early and define mitigation strategies. Collaborate with hardware, ISP, Android/Linux platform, and product teams. Mentor senior engineers and provide architectural governance. Contribute to long-term vision/AI roadmap across product generations. Mandatory Skills Description: - Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related field (PhD preferred). 10-15+ years of experience in imaging/vision/perception systems. Proven experience architecting and shipping multiple consumer products with vision/AI. Deep understanding of imaging pipeline (sensor behavior, ISP, tuning impact). Strong embedded system architecture experience. Expert-level C++ and system-level optimization knowledge. Strong expertise in CV and ML system integration. Experience deploying optimized ML models on consumer SoCs. Experience with heterogeneous compute architectures. Experience defining system-level KPIs and validation strategies. Strong cross-functional leadership and communication skills. Languages: English: B2 Upper Intermediate

title: Consultor De Customer Success | Experiência & Adoção | Ia
description:

Our API-first, developer-first platform turns complex data into faster, smarter, actionable decisions for global customers across financial services, retail, healthcare, and technology. With the recent launch of client Intelligence and Intelligence Assistant, we're accelerating innovation in embedded analytics, enabling governed, scalable AI experiences that bridge insights to real-time action. The Role As a Strategic Customer Success Manager, you will serve as a trusted advisor to mid-sized to large enterprise accounts, building deep relationships to maximize value, drive adoption of our AI-powered platform, and fuel retention and expansion. You'll collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Product, Engineering, and Support to ensure customers achieve their business goals through clear communication of complex concepts and proactive guidance. Why Join Our Customer Success Team This is a strategic, high-impact role where you'll own complex accounts, strengthen multi-threaded relationships, and deliver measurable outcomes (e.G., NRR, expansion revenue, AI feature adoption). You'll work in a collaborative, innovative global environment, partnering with diverse teams to solve real customer challenges and contribute to product growth in embedded AI analytics. About You You thrive in fast-paced, evolving environments, adapting quickly while staying positive and solution-focused. You're a natural relationship builder, skilled at nurturing trusted, multi-level partnerships and positioning yourself as a key advisor to drive customer success. You quickly grasp business goals and technical concepts (including AI/analytics platforms) to align solutions with customer needs. You're proactive and consultative, identifying opportunities, anticipating challenges, and advocating for customers while balancing business priorities. You're collaborative, open to feedback, and passionate about delivering results through continuous learning and improvement. Requirements 3–5+ years as a Customer Success Manager (or equivalent), with proven success managing enterprise/mid-market accounts (SaaS/BI/analytics preferred). Strong track record of driving product adoption, value realization, and revenue expansion. Excellent presentation and executive communication skills;
experience leading EBRs/QBRs and building C-level relationships. Ability to own full account planning, health monitoring, and success strategy across a portfolio. Proactive mindset: identify upsell/cross-sell opportunities, mitigate risks, and deliver measurable ROI. Project management skills to handle complex implementations, onboarding, and technical discussions. Experience collaborating cross-functionally (Sales, Product, Engineering) to resolve issues and influence roadmaps. Exceptional interpersonal, listening, written, and verbal skills (fluent English required;
Portuguese a plus). Results-driven with strong critical thinking, problem-solving, and a customer-centric focus. Comfortable in a dynamic, remote environment while managing multiple priorities. Bonus: Background in Business Intelligence (BI), embedded analytics, AI/GenAI enablement, or similar technical solutions. How You'll Ramp By Day 30 Complete Customer Success onboarding and training (client values, culture, relationship techniques, product overview, competition, and transformational outcomes). Begin meeting customers, shadowing QBRs/EBRs, and observing how we build relationships and deliver value. By Day 60 Develop strategic account plans for your portfolio and start driving opportunities (adoption, expansion, renewals). Deepen product and technical knowledge through coaching and hands-on work. Fully embed with your accounts and collaborate side by side with the team. By Day 90 Own your book of business end-to-end, driving partnership success and measurable results (NRR, adoption, expansion). Master Customer Success best practices, including onboarding, proactive risk management, and AI feature enablement. Become a key contributor to the team's revenue retention and growth goals. Join Client!Our client is pioneering the future of embedded analytics with AI at the core. This role offers more than a position — it’s an opportunity to shape customer outcomes in a transformative industry, work with a diverse, innovative global team, and grow in a collaborative culture that values impact and inclusivity. If you're passionate about driving strategic customer success in AI-powered analytics, apply today. Let’s build the next era of intelligent decisions together.

title: Product Manager Sênior - Planejamento Comercial
description:
Sobre a posição no jogo Estamos em busca de uma pessoa Product Manager Sênior para liderar a evolução das soluções de Planejamento Comercial, atuando na interseção entre negócio, dados e tecnologia. Essa posição tem como missão maximizar a rentabilidade e a eficiência do portfólio de produtos, conectando o ciclo de vida do produto (PLM) à inteligência de mercado e ao planejamento de compras, garantindo decisões orientadas por dados, menor time-to-market e melhor alocação de capital em estoque. Você será responsável por transformar dores do time comercial (Buying & Planning) em produtos digitais escaláveis, garantindo adoção real, automação e impacto direto em KPIs críticos do negócio. Missão da Área Maximizar a rentabilidade e a eficiência do portfólio de produtos através da tecnologia, integrando o ciclo de vida do produto (PLM) à inteligência de mercado, para suportar decisões de compra e sortimento orientadas por dados, com maior agilidade e menor risco. Objetivos estratégicos do produto Digitalização do ciclo de vida do Produto;
Implementar e evoluir a plataforma de PLM, centralizando o desenvolvimento desde o conceito até a ficha técnica final;
Inteligência de Compra e Planejamento;
Criarou integrar soluções que automatizem o cálculo de OTB (Open to Buy) e recomendem sortimento ideal por canal, região e perfil de demanda. Conexão com o Mercado;
Traduzir tendências,dados de concorrência e sinais de mercado em parâmetros técnicos para o desenvolvimento e planejamento de novos produtos;
Eficiência Operacional;
Reduzir rupturas, excessos de estoque e markdowns por meio de previsões de demanda, planejamento integrado e automação de processos. Responsabilidades Definir e liderar a visão e estratégia do produto de Planejamento Comercial, alinhando tecnologia às necessidades do negócio;
Gerenciar a evoluçãocontínua das ferramentas de PLM e Planning, garantindo estabilidade, escalabilidade e adoção;
Atuar como braço tecnológico do time comercial, conduzindo discovery com compradores, planejadores e áreas correlatas;
Traduzir dores de negócio em soluções digitais, processos otimizados e integrações sistêmicas ;
Garantir a arquitetura e integridade dos dados de produto, do nascimento no PLM até a venda no PDV e e-commerce;
Avaliar e conduzir decisões de Build vs. Buy, considerando custo, tempo, escalabilidade e aderência ao negócio;
Priorizar roadmap e backlog com base em impacto em rentabilidade, eficiência operacional e risco de estoque ;
Trabalhar emparceria com Engenharia, Dados, SAP e fornecedores externos;
Garantir queo plano de compras aprovado seja convertido em pedidos automatizados (PO) no SAP, com mínima intervenção manual;
Monitorar e comunicarresultados por meio de KPIs claros e orientados a impacto. Escopo Tecnológico Você atuará diretamente na evolução e integração dos seguintes pilares: PLM (Product Lifecycle Management) Desenvolvimento de produtos, fornecedores, custos, ciclo de vida e cadastros. Demand Planning & Analytics Modelagem de dados e algoritmos para suporte ao planejamento de compras. Market Intelligence Hub Integração de APIs e dados externos de mercado e concorrência. ERP (SAP – MM / Retail) Integração robusta para automação do ciclo de compra, pedidos e cadastros. Automação do Planejamento para Pedido Conversão de planejamento em Pedidos de Compra (PO) automáticos Sincronização de mestres (materiais e fornecedores) Monitoramento de status de recebimento e notas fiscais Requisitos Obrigatórios Experiência sólida como Product Manager Sênior em contextos de varejo, indústria ou operações comerciais complexas ;
Conhecimentoprofundo do ciclo de vida do produto (PLM, Buying, Planning, Supply) ;
Experiência atuando com sistemas corporativos e integrações (ex.: ERP, PLM, Planning);
Forte capacidade analítica, com uso de dados para tomada de decisão ;
Vivência em discoverycom áreas não-digitais (ex.: Comercial, Compras, Planejamento);
Experiência com metodologias ágeis ;
Comunicação clara, estruturada e habilidade em negociação de prioridades com múltiplos stakeholders. Diferenciais Desejáveis Experiência prévia com SAP MM ou SAP Retail ;
Conhecimentoem OTB (Open to Buy), planejamento de sortimento e previsão de demanda;
Domínio de SQL, Power BI ou ferramentas analíticas similares ;
Experiência em decisões de Build vs. Buy e gestão de fornecedores de software;
Atuação em ambientes de transformação digital de áreas comerciais. O que define sucesso nessa posição Redução do lead time do ciclo de desenvolvimento de produtos (briefing → venda);
Alta taxade adoção das ferramentas pelo time de Compras e Planejamento;
Crescimento do percentual de pedidos automatizados (Zero-Touch PO) ;
Melhor aderência ao OTB planejado ;
Redução de markdownse maior venda a preço cheio. Por que essa vaga é especial? Porque você vai liderar um produto que atua no coração da decisão comercial da empresa, conectando estratégia, dados e execução. Aqui, decisões de produto impactam diretamente margem, capital investido em estoque e velocidade de reação ao mercado. É uma posição para quem gosta de complexidade real, influência transversal e impacto mensurável no resultado do negócio. Bora movimentar o esporte.

title: Salvador - Gerente Isabela Braga | Vendas – Seguro de Vida e Previdência (Autônomo - Atuação Pr[]
description:
Overview

Já pensou em redirecionar sua carreira ou aprender uma nova profissão? Agora imagine só, poder fazer isso sendo parceiro de uma empresa que, há quase 200 anos, ajuda as pessoas a planejar um futuro financeiro mais tranquilo. Aqui na MAG, nossos corretores parceiros são chamados de Especialistas em Proteção Financeira.

E se você tem tino comercial, gosta de se relacionar com pessoas, tem perfil empreendedor e deseja trabalhar com o forte propósito de prover soluções financeiras individuais nos diversos momentos de vida de todos os brasileiros, nosso Programa para Formação de Especialistas em Proteção Financeira é a oportunidade ideal para você! Sabemos bem que um processo de mudança de carreira pode ser algo difícil. Mas, participando de nosso Programa, você terá todo o suporte necessário para ser bem sucedido, desde o treinamento em sala de aula – onde aprenderá mais sobre a empresa, seu portfólio e o processo de vendas – até o acompanhamento em campo, onde realizará – com a supervisão de nossos líderes especialistas – as primeiras entrevistas de vendas.

Vantagens
  • Além de toda estrutura de suporte, treinamento e acompanhamento, poderemos apoiá-lo financeiramente na fase inicial de constituição de seu negócio, mediante o atingimento de critérios mínimos de produtividade.
  • Subsídios de até 70% para adquirir produtos como plano de saúde, de telefonia móvel, seguros de vida, notebook e smartphone, mediante elegibilidade ao nosso Programa de Fidelidade.
  • Comissionamento vitalício sobre grande parte das coberturas comercializadas, ou seja, a comissão é do corretor pelo tempo em que o contrato do cliente estiver ativo, permitindo ganhos ilimitados.
  • Atuação presencial, com relacionamento multicanal, que pode ser realizado via unidades de vendas, telefone, WhatsApp, e-mail e chat, além de portal exclusivo para corretores.
  • Campanhas de vendas periódicas, que premiam os vencedores, além do reconhecimento e distinção, com incríveis viagens de turismo ou de desenvolvimento. Acesse vida.mag.com.br/mag-365.
  • Conversão das vendas em pontos que podem ser trocados por mais de 50 mil itens disponíveis em um catálogo virtual.
Responsabilidades e Atribuições
  • Inicialmente, se dedicará exclusivamente ao curso preparatório da MAG Universidade para obtenção da habilitação técnico profissional junto a Susep.
  • Identificará potenciais clientes para abordar, utilizando sua Rede de Relacionamento para agendamento de entrevistas de vendas e solicitação de indicações.
  • Fará telemarketing ativo para agendar entrevistas de vendas.
  • Realizará as entrevistas de vendas, identificando as necessidades de proteção financeira do prospect e ofertando as soluções mais adequadas a cada perfil.
  • Gerenciará a sua carteira de clientes com foco na sustentabilidade financeira do seu negócio.
Requisitos e Qualificações
  • Ensino médio completo.
  • Aptidão para vendas.
  • Amplo círculo social (network/rede de relacionamento).
  • Perfil ativo nas redes sociais.
  • Experiência como profissional autônomo, liberal ou empreendedor.
  • Experiência com venda consultiva e rotina de vendas externas.
Informações Adicionais
  • São aguerridas, motivadas, resilientes e persistentes, dedicando à construção do sucesso de seu próprio negócio.
  • Identificam-se com o propósito de despertar nas pessoas o desejo e a necessidade de assegurar o próprio futuro e o das pessoas que amam.
  • Possuem ampla rede de relacionamento, frequentam grupos sociais ligados a esporte, religião, hobbies, culinária, educação, negócios ou qualquer outro tema que permita estar em contato frequente com diferentes pessoas, ampliando o círculo social.
  • Possuem como prioridades o sucesso profissional e os ganhos financeiros, independente de regime de contratação de trabalho.
  • Têm disponibilidade para atuar conforme agenda do cliente, possuindo flexibilidade na rotina de trabalho, para atendimento além dos horários convencionais.
  • Atuam com disciplina no planejamento semanal das atividades de vendas, de acordo com os parâmetros necessários para o atingimento e superação dos objetivos financeiros e pessoais.
  • Dedicam-se ao estudo contínuo em busca de novos conhecimentos, mantendo-se atualizadas profissionalmente.
Sobre a MAG

Com mais de 6 milhões de clientes e cerca de R$ 475 bilhões assegurados, somos especialistas no desenvolvimento de soluções personalizadas em seguros de vida e planos de previdência individuais e corporativos. Em 2009, nos associamos ao Grupo Aegon, presente em mais de 20 países ao redor do mundo. Hoje, somos a terceira maior seguradora independente do Brasil e contamos com 38 unidades de vendas físicas espalhadas pelo Brasil, que servem de base para o trabalho de mais de seis mil corretores parceiros.

  • Liderar projetos de melhoria contínua da experiência.

  • Estruturar processos de acompanhamento e relacionamento com clientes após a compra.

Análise de Dados e Inteligência de Cliente:

title: SUPERVISOR DA QUALIDADE
description:
SUPERVISOR(A) DA QUALIDADE
REQUISITOS DA VAGA

  • Escolaridade: Superior Completo. Formação: Engenharia Mecânica, Metalúrgica, de Petróleo, de Materiais ou de Produção.

  • Idiomas: Inglês avançado obrigatório (leitura, escrita, audição e conversação) a ser avaliado na entrevista.

  • Informática: Pacote Office avançado e vivência com sistemas ERP (SAP, Siemens ou similares).

  • Experiência desejável: mínimo de 05 anos atuando na mesma função, obrigatoriamente em indústria, na liderança de equipes de Controle da Qualidade e de Garantia da Qualidade.


ESPECÍFICOS

  • Larga experiência na implantação, manutenção e melhoria de Sistemas de Gestão Integrados ISO 9001, 14001 e 45001, tendo atuado como auditor líder em SGI conforme a ISO 19011.

  • Vivência na gestão da qualidade de projetos, incluindo análise dos requisitos técnicos e normativos (nacionais e internacionais), emissão de documentos de garantia e de controle da qualidade nas etapas de fabricação, de inspeção e de testes em materiais, componentes semi-acabados e produtos finais.

  • Domínio e aplicação de ferramentas da Qualidade para solução de problemas (A3, 8D Report, 5Why, Diagrama Ishikawa) e da metodologia FMEA para análise preventiva de falhas.

  • Experiência na interação direta com áreas Comercial, Engenharia, Suprimentos e de Produção nas diversas fases do projeto e da fabricação.

  • Atuação direta na interface junto a fornecedores e clientes através de reuniões, visitas, auditorias presenciais de processos e sistemas, incluindo eventos de inspeção, testes e/ou fabricação de produtos.


PRINCIPAIS ATRIBUIÇÕES

  • Supervisar as atividades de Controle da Qualidade, incluindo inspeções de recebimento de materiais, inspeção durante a fabricação e testes de aceitação de produtos finais, conforme requisitos técnicos normativos (ABNT, ASTM, ASME, API, ISO), de acordo com planos da qualidade, de inspeção e de testes.

  • Participar das reuniões de projetos, internas (Kick-off meeting) e externas (Pre Inspection/Production Meetings – PIM/PPM) com clientes e fornecedores, planejando as demandas das equipes da Qualidade.

  • Planejar e distribuir as demandas e responsabilidades das equipes de Controle e de Garantia da Qualidade.

  • Liderar as demandas do Sistema de Gestão Integrado, incluindo manutenção e melhoria contínua do SGQ conforme a ISO 9001, certificação e manutenção dos sistemas SGA e SSO nas normas ISO 14001 e ISO 45001.

  • Coordenar no ERP a gestão de documentos, de não conformidades, de riscos e de mudanças, incluindo planos de ação, processos e tratativas no sistema com gestores das áreas interna, fornecedores e clientes.

  • Planejar e acompanhar no ERP os recursos necessários para as inspeções e testes de recebimento de materiais e inspeções e testes nos produtos, conforme programação da fábrica e cronograma dos projetos.

  • Elaborar no ERP planos de controle/garantia da qualidade dos projetos, conforme requisitos dos clientes, incluindo emissão dos certificados de conformidade e aprovação de data book de fabricação dos produtos.

  • Atuar no desenvolvimento de novos fornecedores e no monitoramento da performance dos fornecedores existentes, em conformidade com os requisitos do Sistema de Gestão da Qualidade.

  • Assegurar estrutura adequada para laboratórios, áreas de testes, equipamentos e instalações, conforme requisitos técnicos e de SSMA.

  • Levantar, planejar e coordenar treinamentos conforme demandas da empresa e procedimentos do SGI.

description:
Descrição da vaga

Estamos em busca de profissionais apaixonados por tecnologia para atuar em um ambiente dinâmico e estratégico na área de Projetos , contribuindo diretamente para a disponibilidade, segurança e performance da infraestrutura tecnológica da empresa.

Nesta posição, você será responsável por coordenar iniciativas estratégicas de TI e infraestrutura digital entre a área de TI Global da BYD (China) e as operações no Brasil. Garante a execução dos projetos, o alinhamento entre stakeholders, a conformidade com a governança e a comunicação entre equipes multilíngues. Liderará o planejamento, execução e entrega de programas de infraestrutura de TI, redes, datacenter e transformação digital alinhados aos padrões globais da BYD e aos objetivos operacionais regionais.

Responsabilidades e atribuições
  • Liderar atividades de gestão de projetos de TI de ponta a ponta, incluindo planejamento, cronograma, controle de riscos e governança de entrega alinhados aos padrões de BYD Global IT.
  • Atuar como principal elo bilíngue entre a sede da BYD na China e as equipes operacionais no Brasil, garantindo comunicação precisa em mandarim, português e, quando necessário, inglês.
  • Coordenar projetos de infraestrutura, redes, datacenter, cyber segurança e plataformas digitais entre equipes multifuncionais.
  • Desenvolver e manter roadmaps de projetos, marcos e planejamento de recursos alinhados aos objetivos estratégicos corporativos.
  • Gerenciar orçamentos de projetos, coordenação de aquisições e avaliação de desempenho de fornecedores.
  • Facilitar relatórios executivos e revisões de governança, fornecendo dashboards de progresso e insights para tomada de decisão da liderança sênior.
  • Garantir que os projetos estejam em conformidade com frameworks de governança de TI da BYD, padrões corporativos e requisitos regulatórios regionais.
  • Coordenar processos de gestão de mudanças para implantações de infraestrutura e transições operacionais.
  • Identificar riscos de projetos, dependências e estratégias de mitigação para garantir cumprimento de cronograma e qualidade.
  • Apoiar a integração entre iniciativas de infraestrutura de TI e operações industriais em ambientes de manufatura.
  • Colaborar com equipes de cyber segurança, redes, datacenter e suporte, garantindo alinhamento com prontidão operacional e continuidade de serviços.
  • Organizar e liderar reuniões de projetos interculturais, traduzindo discussões técnicas e estratégicas entre equipes de mandarim e português.
  • Manter repositórios de documentação de projetos, incluindo termos de abertura, registros de riscos, relatórios de governança e resumos executivos.
  • Promover melhoria contínua na governança de projetos, padrões de documentação e colaboração entre regiões.
  • Fornecer mentoria e orientação para coordenadores de projetos e analistas juniores dentro da estrutura do PMO.
Requisitos e qualificações
  • Graduação em Tecnologia da Informação, Engenharia de Sistemas ou áreas relacionadas;
  • Conhecimento sólido em plataformas de virtualização (VMware, Hyper‑V) e gerenciamento de armazenamento;
  • Experiência em operações de backup, validação de recuperação de dados e monitoramento com Zabbix, PRTG ou Grafana;
  • Conhecimento de conceitos de DRP/BCP, métricas RTO/RPO e testes de recuperação de desastres;
  • Conhecimento de ambientes de servidores Windows e Linux, redes e gestão de capacidade;
  • Familiaridade com frameworks ISO 27001 e ITIL, garantindo alinhamento de documentação e conformidade;
  • Forte capacidade analítica e de troubleshooting para incidentes de hardware e software;
  • Inglês avançado para documentação técnica e comunicação com fornecedores e stakeholders;
  • Capacidade de coordenar manutenção de fornecedores e validar entregáveis;
  • Alto nível de disciplina operacional, controle de configuração e rotinas de manutenção preventiva;
  • Conhecimento das normas de segurança NR aplicáveis a operações de datacenter e conformidade com EHS;
  • Disponibilidade para participar de testes de DRP/BCP e operações em turnos;
  • Certificação em VMware Certified Professional – VCP (Data Center Virtualization); Microsoft Server Administrator e/ou ITIL Foundation (Service Operations ou Service Transition);

Desejável:

  • Certificação em Microsoft Certified: Windows Server Administrator (MCSA) ou Azure Administrator (AZ-104);
  • CompTIA Network+ ou Cloud+ (compreensão de redes de datacenter);
  • Veeam Certified Engineer (VMCE) ou Veritas NetBackup Administrator;
  • ISO/IEC 27001 Internal Auditor (desejável);
  • Certificação profissional de monitoramento Zabbix / PRTG;
  • Red Hat Certified System Administrator (RHCSA) – opcional.
Informações adicionais

Aqui na BYD priorizamos o bem-estar de nossos colaboradores e estamos em busca constante de melhorias para o nosso pacote de benefícios. Seu pacote vai contar com:

  • Convênio médico e odontológico para você e seus dependentes;
  • Cartão Golden Farma para compras em farmácias cadastradas com desconto diretamente em folha, valendo tanto para medicamentos como para itens de higiene e beleza;
  • Well Hub para cuidar da sua saúde física e mental;
  • Alimentação em refeitório e Vale Alimentação para te ajudar nas compras do mês;
  • Transporte Fretado ou Auxilio Combustível;
  • Seguro de vida coletivo Porto Seguro, sem desconto em folha;

title: Principal Genesys Cloud PS Consultant
description:
Company Description

Miratech helps visionaries change the world. We are a global IT services and consulting company that brings together enterprise and start-up innovation. Today, we support digital transformation for some of the world's largest enterprises. By partnering with both large and small players, we stay at the leading edge of technology, remain nimble even as a global leader, and create technology that helps our clients further enhance their business. We are a values-driven organization and our culture of Relentless Performance has enabled over 99% of Miratech's engagements to succeed by meeting or exceeding our scope, schedule, and/or budget objectives since our inception in 1989. Miratech has coverage across 5 continents and operates in over 25 countries around the world. Miratech retains nearly 1000 full-time professionals, and our annual growth rate exceeds 25%.

Job Description

We are looking for a Principal Genesys Cloud Professional Services Consultant to join our team and drive the delivery of innovative, enterprise-grade contact center solutions.

In this role, you will lead the design and implementation of advanced multi-channel customer experience platforms, leveraging deep expertise in Genesys Cloud and modern contact center technologies.

The ideal candidate combines strong technical leadership, hands‑on delivery experience, and the ability to translate complex business requirements into scalable, high‑quality solutions.

Responsibilities
  • Serve as the primary technical point of contact for customers and internal stakeholders, providing expert consultancy on Genesys Cloud solutions.
  • Lead the design and delivery of end‑to‑end technical solutions, including facilitating workshops, gathering requirements, and producing technical design documentation with stakeholder sign‑off.
  • Analyze complex business and technical challenges to define scalable and effective solution architectures.
  • Own and evolve the technical architecture of Genesys solutions, introducing new technologies and best practices where appropriate.
  • Configure and optimize Genesys Cloud environments to align with changing business and operational needs.
  • Lead the planning and execution of contact center deployments, migrations, and system upgrades.
  • Act as the main escalation and coordination point for Genesys‑related matters, collaborating with internal teams and external vendors.
  • Support production readiness activities and ensure smooth transition of contact center solutions into live environments.
Qualifications
  • 5+ years of hands‑on experience supporting and optimizing large, multi‑site, complex contact center environments.
  • Experience in designing, implementing, and supporting Genesys Cloud solutions in enterprise settings.
  • Proven expertise in building routing strategies and IVR workflows using Genesys Architect
  • Experience with CRM integration (e.g., Salesforce, MS Dynamics) with the Genesys Cloud environment
  • Strong background in infrastructure planning, solution design, deployment, and lifecycle management to ensure high availability and performance.
  • Solid understanding of business processes and their alignment with customer experience technologies.
  • Deep knowledge of SIP infrastructure, including SIP protocol, Session Border Controllers (SBC), and load balancing approaches.
Nice to Have
  • Knowledge of Genesys Cloud Workforce Management (WFM): provide expert guidance and best practices to optimize workforce management processes within the Genesys Cloud environment.
  • Genesys Cloud Training: conduct training sessions for various roles, including supervisors, administrators, users, and architects, to enhance their understanding and effective use of Genesys Cloud features
  • Experience with CX Cloud from Genesys and Salesforce
Additional Information

We offer:

  • Competitive Pay and Benefits: enjoy a comprehensive compensation and benefits package, including health insurance, and a relocation program.
  • Work From Anywhere Culture: make the most of the flexibility that comes with remote work.
  • Growth Mindset: reap the benefits of a range of professional development opportunities, including certification programs, mentorship and talent investment programs, internal mobility and internship opportunities.
  • Global Impact: collaborate on impactful projects for top global clients and shape the future of industries.
  • Welcoming Multicultural Environment: be a part of a dynamic, global team and thrive in an inclusive and supportive work environment with open communication and regular team‑building company social events.
  • Social Sustainability Values: join our sustainable business practices focused on five pillars, including IT education, community empowerment, fair operating practices, environmental sustainability, and gender equality.

* Miratech is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other protected status under applicable law.

Quer ser um diretor escolar de excelência? Vem com a gente! ️

Assumir a direção de uma escola vai muito além de ocupar um cargo: é uma oportunidade única de impactar vidas e deixar um legado na educação. Aqui no Grupo Salta, oferecemos a chance de iniciar uma jornada que vai expandir ainda mais o seu potencial. Ao fazer parte do nosso time de diretores, você vai liderar uma das escolas do maior grupo de educação básica do Brasil, inspirando as vidas da sua comunidade escolar e deixando a sua marca no cenário educacional do nosso país.

Juntos, podemos construir um futuro em que a educação seja dinâmica, transformadora e fortalecida em uma cultura de excelência. Vamos transformar histórias: a sua, a nossa e a da educação de todo o Brasil.

O primeiro passo para a excelência começa aqui. Vem com a gente e faça parte desse legado! ✨

  • Gestão da equipe pedagógica e administrativa: Supervisionar e orientar as equipes pedagógicas e administrativas, promovendo o desenvolvimento profissional e garantindo o alinhamento com as metas institucionais;

  • Captação e retenção de alunos: Atuar em estratégias de marketing educacional, elaborando planos de captação e fidelização de alunos, e promover uma experiência positiva para as famílias, consolidando a escola como referência de excelência na região;
  • Inovação e excelência: Incentivar a integração de tecnologia e práticas inovadoras no ensino, acompanhando tendências educacionais e implementando melhorias contínuas no currículo e na metodologia da escola.
  • Formação superior completa em Pedagogia, Educação ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência sólida em gestão escolar, preferencialmente em instituições de grande porte;
  • Forte capacidade de liderança, comunicação e tomada de decisão;
  • Cursar ou ter cursado pós-graduação em Gestão Escolar é um diferencial.

Acreditamos que um time diverso é o caminho para cumprir a nossa missão de transformar vidas e o Brasil. Assim, incentivamos a candidatura de pessoas que se identifiquem com grupos minorizados em todas as nossas posições.

Fique tranquilo (a) ao cadastrar seus dados na vaga. O Grupo Salta segue a LGPD – Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados (Lei Federal 13.709/2018), que entrou em vigor em agosto de 2020, logo, garantimos responsabilidade ao utilizar seus dados somente em nosso processo seletivo, para fins de cadastro e controle de candidatos.

CONHEÇA O GRUPO SALTA EDUCAÇÃO

Somos o maior grupo de educação básica do Brasil e temos a missão de construir um país melhor para as próximas gerações. Quer saber como fazemos isso?

Acreditamos que o ensino de qualidade pode ser um modelo sustentável para impactar crianças e jovens em todo o país. E esse desafio nos move diariamente.

Para realizar esse sonho, contamos com um time inovador e criativo, cheio de energia e, principalmente, apaixonado pelo que faz. O nosso DNA é marcado pela cultura de excelência, impacto social, desenvolvimento pessoal e espírito realizador.

Acreditamos que um time diverso é o caminho para cumprir a nossa missão de transformar vidas e, por isso, visamos a contratar talentos em igualdade de oportunidades. Também levamos a inclusão a sério, pensando em processos de reconhecimento justos e éticos, além de contarmos com grupos de afinidade racial, LGBTQIA+, de pessoas com deficiência e de gênero.

Se você quer ser impulsionado para impulsionar, o Grupo Salta é o seu lugar. Venha construir um legado de transformação conosco!

Ford abre vagas para 150 funcionários em Camaçari

14 de Julho de 2017 | 16h 57

Foto: Reprodução

Para aumentar a produção da fábrica, a montadora Ford, localizada no Polo Industrial de Camaçari, divulgou a abertura de cerca de 150 vagas para funcionários. “A Ford confirma que, durante o mês de julho, vai realizar cerca de 150 contratações para atender demanda de exportação”, disse a empresa em nota.

Para o diretor da montadora, Ricardo Menezes, com as novas contratações, a produção deverá aumentar de 900 para 1.100 carros por dia. A seleção será realizada pela empresa RH e Cia . A Ford, porém, não informou os detalhes dos cargos e da seleção. As informações são do Jornal Correio.

title: Product Manager (Senior/Lead) ID42374
description:
AgileEngine is an Inc. 5000 company that creates award-winning software for Fortune 500 brands and trailblazing startups across 17+ industries. We rank among the leaders in areas like application development and AI/ML, and our people-first culture has earned us multiple Best Place to Work awards.

WHY JOIN US

If you're looking for a place to grow, make an impact, and work with people who care, we'd love to meet you!

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Product Manager , you’ll define strategy, lead teams, and deliver digital products that engage millions of users worldwide. Combining data-driven insights with market knowledge, you’ll shape product vision, mentor peers, and collaborate across functions. This role offers high impact, growth, and the chance to influence the future of digital media .

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Product Strategy – Develop and communicate a clear product strategy and vision for IGN’s digital platforms and products, aligning it with the company’s goals and objectives
  • Product Leadership – Lead multiple product teams and drive product strategy for a larger portfolio of products.
  • Team Leadership – Lead and mentor a team of product managers, providing guidance and support to help them achieve their goals and deliver high-quality products.
  • Product Roadmap – Define and maintain the product roadmap for multiple products, ensuring it aligns with business priorities, user needs, and market trends. Make data-driven decisions and prioritize features accordingly.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration – Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including engineering, design, editorial, and marketing, to ensure successful product development and delivery.
  • User Research – Conduct and analyze user research to gain a deep understanding of user needs, preferences, and pain points. Use this data to inform product decisions and improvements.
  • User Experience (UX) – Work with UX/UI designers to create user-friendly and visually appealing products. Ensure a seamless and engaging user experience across IGN’s digital platforms.
  • Data Analysis – Utilize data analytics and key performance indicators (KPIs) to monitor product performance, identify areas for improvement, and make data-driven decisions to optimize the product.
  • Product Development – Oversee the end-to-end product development process, from ideation to release. Coordinate with development teams to deliver high-quality products on schedule.
  • Project Management – Define and prioritize product features, enhancements, and requirements based on customer feedback, market research, and business impact. Collaborate with product managers to ensure that product feature prioritization aligns with the overall product strategy and roadmap.
  • Product Launch – Plan and execute successful product launches, including marketing strategies and user communication. Monitor product performance post-launch and iterate based on user feedback.
  • Stakeholder Communication – Keep stakeholders informed about the status of ongoing projects, milestones, and potential roadblocks. Maintain transparency and ensure alignment with business goals.
  • Market and Competitive Analysis – Stay informed about industry trends, emerging technologies, and the competitive landscape to identify opportunities and threats in the market.
  • User Feedback and Support – Engage with user feedback, reviews, and support channels to address user concerns, gather insights, and drive product improvements.

MUST HAVES

  • 5-7 years working on technology-powered products as either a product manager or user researcher;
  • Strong understanding of digital media platforms, technologies, and industry trends ;
  • Proven ability to build intuitive content management systems that meet both internal and external customer needs;
  • Experience in building subscription-based products with a track record of driving growth;
  • Led product development on complex features from 1st to Nth interaction;
  • A history of deep and demonstrated understanding of the techniques and methods of modern product discovery and product delivery;
  • Demonstrated ability to figure out solutions to hard problems with many constraints, using sound judgment to assess risks, and to lay out your argument in a well-structured, data-informed, written narrative;
  • Proven ability to engage with engineers, designers, and company leaders in a constructive and collaborative relationship;
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience;
  • Upper-Intermediate English level.

NICE TO HAVES

  • Deep understanding of gaming trends;
  • Strong background in app development and design.

PERKS AND BENEFITS

  • Professional growth: Accelerate your professional journey with mentorship, TechTalks, and personalized growth roadmaps.
  • Competitive compensation: We match your ever-growing skills, talent, and contributions with competitive USD-based compensation and budgets for education, fitness, and team activities.
  • A selection of exciting projects: Join projects with modern solutions development and top-tier clients that include Fortune 500 enterprises and leading product brands.
  • Flextime: Tailor your schedule for an optimal work-life balance, by having the options of working from home and going to the office – whatever makes you the happiest and most productive.

title: Director of Ecommerce
description:
Based in San Francisco and handcrafted in Spain, Frēda Salvador is building community from the ground up. Footwear and accessories handmade in our family factories in Spain and EL Salvador.

We are a fast paced start up and are hustling everyday. We are driven. We are small, but mighty with strong values in teamwork and a positive and supportive work environment.

We are looking for a passionate, analytical, and creative Ecom & Digital leader. This role will drive the ecom business efforts across all digital channels. The ideal candidate is passionate about our customer data, understands fashion & luxury products, and knows how to drive the full funnel Ecommerce experience. This role owns all aspects of Ecommerce.

ABOUT THE ROLE

The Director of Ecommerce & Retention will own and lead the Fredasalvador.com business. This leader is responsible for the full-funnel ecommerce experience, from guiding customer acquisition in partnership with performance marketing teams to owning the entire post-purchase lifecycle. You will own the ecommerce P&L, lead financial forecasting, and serve as the strategic engine for digital growth, scaling the brand through data-driven decisions and best-in-class customer experiences.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  • P&L & Forecasting: Take full accountability for hitting monthly, quarterly, and annual ecommerce sales plans. Lead both top-down and bottom-up financial forecasting, identifying proactive opportunities and reactive pivots based on business trends. Partner with planning, merchandising and paid media teams.
  • Channel Leadership: Drive the ecommerce business efforts across all digital and direct mail channels.
  • Budget Oversight: Direct responsibility for managing the annual and monthly Ecommerce P&L, including management and authority for third-party technology.
  • Identify new opportunities for scale, and partner with leadership to execute.
  • Consistent awareness of competitive landscape and key action items
  • Lead data analytics reporting, and utilize insights to drive scale.
  • Identify evolving technology needs and execute new initiatives.
  • Drive scale sustainably, work towards scale within the company budget finding creative ways to maximize and optimize while testing new initiatives.
  • People/Team Management. Leading, coaching, upskilling and mentoring of direct reports.
  • Be customer obsessed, drive loyalty and retention.
  • Monitor and analyze customer lifecycle, create strategies to drive growth.
2. CRM, Lifecycle & Retention (Full Ownership)
  • Retention Strategy: Own the "Repeat Customer Rate" and "LTV" metrics. Develop and revamp comprehensive lifecycle marketing strategies to drive customer loyalty.
  • Email & SMS: Own and run end-to-end programs, from campaign planning and A/B testing to execution and performance analysis.
  • Loyalty & Referrals: Level up the Yotpo Loyalty program, making recommendations to improve engagement, reward redemption, and "Refer a Friend" initiatives.
  • CRM Analytics: Partner with agencies to build advanced customer segments for highly targeted email and on-site experiences.
  • Shopify Management: Oversee day-to-day site operations, including product launches, collection updates, and promotions.
  • User Experience: Coordinate plans for CRO and UX/UI testing to optimize engagement and conversion.
  • Cross-Functional Alignment: Partner with Planning and Merchandising to ensure the digital channel has the right assortments and inventory to support the forecast.
  • Directly responsible for managing the budget and relationship with our external development team; working closely to not only maintain the site but work towards ongoing site optimization and enhancement.
4. Marketing & Paid Media Support
  • Performance Partnership: you will serve as the strategic partner to the growth team, digital agency and marketing team to support growth across all paid channels (PPC, SEO, Social, Affiliate, and Influencer Marketing) as these channels relate to driving the forecast.
  • Conversion Optimization: Provide conversion, product, and landing page recommendations to marketing and agency partners to ensure a seamless experience for traffic coming from performance media.
REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE
  • Experience: 6+ years in digital brand strategy, e-commerce and digital marketing, with 2+ years of experience leading and managing a team.
  • Technical Proficiency: Expert knowledge of Shopify+, Google Analytics, and retention platforms like Attentive or Klaviyo.
  • Analytical Mindset: Proven ability to define and deliver performance metrics and glean actionable creative insights from data.
  • Background: Experience in the fashion or luxury space is preferred, with an entrepreneurial spirit comfortable in a fast-paced startup environment.
COMPANY BENEFITS AND COMPENSATION

This is a full time position. Alongside a unique and incredible culture, FREDA SALVADOR offers competitive salaries commensurate with experience and education and a benefits package that includes flexible vacation time, group medical, dental and vision plans, an employer-sponsored 401K retirement plan, flexible hybrid work schedule, and a generous discounts and shoe gratis program.
